verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a sandbox that mirrors production for running cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end, plus sandbox-only endpoints that simulate merchant-acquirer authorizations. Its MCP/agentic material describes creating cards on a test account and running transactions against rules, which fits AI-native testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server or AI-editor integration targets the sandbox (e.g. sandbox keys or environment switching), details on how sandbox data is isolated from production, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
